claims.claim: Codex limits the initial skill list to two percent of the context window, or eight thousand characters when the window is unknown; descriptions may be shortened and skills may be omitted when the list is large.
claims.provenance_note: Official OpenAI documentation; applies to discovery metadata, not the full SKILL.md after activation.
claims.verification_method: Review the current official product documentation for the exact skill-discovery surface.

claims.claim: Current Codex releases support subagent workflows and surface separate agent threads; each subagent performs its own model and tool work.
claims.provenance_note: Runtime availability can still depend on account, surface, project trust, and configuration.
claims.verification_method: Review official subagent documentation and retain a separate runtime thread ledger for the active host.

claims.claim: OpenAI File Search requires a vector store with files uploaded before it can retrieve from that knowledge base.
claims.provenance_note: A folder of skills or attached documents is not automatically a vector-store RAG system.
claims.verification_method: Review the current official File Search guide for prerequisites and the exact API surface.

claims.claim: OpenAI File Search can filter results using file metadata attributes.
claims.provenance_note: Use metadata boundaries for project, tenant, document class, sensitivity, and version where supported.
claims.verification_method: Review the current official File Search metadata-filter documentation and test a scoped retrieval fixture.

claims.claim: An eval should test a prompt against a representative sample with test inputs and ground-truth labels or explicit grading criteria.
claims.provenance_note: P2P uses a local, project-specific harness; API upload is optional, not required by this package.
claims.verification_method: Review the current official eval guidance and verify the local harness against frozen project fixtures.

claims.claim: Legacy P2P asserted that XML causes a named Gemini degradation labeled G2.
claims.provenance_note: Preserved for audit only; no independent reproducible evidence is attached.
claims.verification_method: Require a frozen reproducible project fixture and an independent rerun before changing runtime behavior.

claims.claim: Legacy P2P asserted that more than roughly seven MUST/MUST NOT pairs cause a named GPT degradation labeled G9.
claims.provenance_note: Treat as an expired hypothesis until a reproducible project eval supports it.
claims.verification_method: Require paired project evals with the same current model and environment before activation.

claims.claim: Legacy P2P asserted that a named Grok topic-drift issue labeled G3 is mitigated by duplicated topic anchors.
claims.provenance_note: Preserved as an expired hypothesis, not an active runtime rule.
claims.verification_method: Require a current reproducible topic-drift fixture and independent evidence before activation.

claims.claim: Legacy RAG routing used fixed corpus-size thresholds to select direct attachment, hierarchical summaries, LongRAG, or GraphRAG.
claims.provenance_note: Calibrate routing with a retrieval eval; corpus count alone is not sufficient.
claims.verification_method: Calibrate on the project's six-class retrieval suite instead of accepting fixed corpus thresholds.
